newsitem.title: FRANCE: Nigeria frees French pilot held since June.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria frees French pilot held since June.

text.p: Nigeria has freed a French pilot detained since June after he made an emergency landing near an area disputed by Nigeria and Cameroon, France said on Wednesday.

Laurent Klinka, released after a plea by French Foreign Minister Herve de Charette, was staying in the French ambassador's residence in Lagos and would fly back to Paris on Saturday, a ministry statement said.
"We are pleased by the happy ending to this affair," a statement said. "We thank the Nigerian authorities and all those who intervened."

Klinka made an emergency landing in June at Nigeria's Calabar airport near the Bakassi peninsula, an oil-rich area disputed by Nigeria and Cameroon. He had been on a flight in a crop-spraying plane from Ivory Coast to Cameroon.
Lagos has accused France of siding with Cameroon, a former colony, in the dispute.
